Package data

Record Class MockDataStore.Sale

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
data.MockDataStore.Sale
Record Components:
id - the order number
time - when the order was placed
employeeId - the cashier who took it
lines - the items sold
subtotal - total before tax and tip, in dollars
tax - sales tax, in dollars
tip - tip, in dollars
method - the payment method
refunded - true once the order is refunded
Enclosing class:
MockDataStore
private static record MockDataStore.Sale(int id, LocalDateTime time, int employeeId, List<MockDataStore.SaleLine> lines, double subtotal, double tax, double tip, String method, boolean refunded) extends Record
One sample sale, like a row of the sales table.
